prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept, reference-guided terrain edit for a top-down game. Create one seamless continuous SQUARE river-terrain extension. Image 1 is exact placement guide over the current game, image 2 is the unmarked current game ground, image 3 is the APPROVED river artwork: match its hand-painted style, rock sizes, water color, detail density, camera angle, short dimensional shadows and illustrative crispness EXACTLY. User loves this look; this is its direct downstream continuation, not a redesign.

Work within image 1's square composition. Preserve the existing river pool and rocks at the TOP LEFT, keeping the first 11% of the image pixel-aligned and visually unchanged from image 2. Open a natural outlet in the SOUTH rim of that existing blue pool, connecting to the guide channel. Paint over the flat grey/blue guide with a beautiful natural river. The river travels from about (25.4%,14%) down to (31.1%,31.8%), curves southeast through (73.7%,67.3%), then turns south into a smaller holding pool centred near (79%,85.8%). Keep the entire new water and banks above the bottom 6% of the image. Width approximately 9% of the square, varying naturally from 7% to 13%, preserving the existing starting pool scale.

Three reaches across the painting: a lovely rocky outflow and low white-water step leaving the existing pool; a sweeping southeast bend with alternating shallow turquoise-blue margins, deep steel-blue middle water, scattered boulder shoulders, small rapids and calm reflective stretches; then a more south-facing current with one modest cascade into a calmer rocky pool near the lower right. Make it spectacular in the same artistic language as image 3. Blue transparent water with submerged stones, delicate elegant white foam, short soft shadows under sculpted grey/brown rocks, naturally uneven damp dirt and gravel shoulders that blend into the SAME brown ground. Keep the river within the indicated route and use organic curved banks instead of polygon corners. All water must be continuously connected. No isolated water holes.

All existing terrain and existing roads outside the river corridor in image 2 must remain in the same positions; preserve the diagonal road visible at the LOWER LEFT. Do not move, repaint, replace or erase that road. Existing rough brown ground continues to the square's edges. NO trees, bushes, grass clumps, new foliage, giant leaves, green-tinted soil, buildings, bridges, characters, labels, borders, vignette, UI or photorealism. No additional roads. Do not zoom or change stone scale. Only extend the water and its banks. One continuous complete painting, not panels or a spritesheet.
animation: Reuse approved river-headwaters-v1 foam atlas and identical motion settings.
